heading: ***FROST ADVISORIES FOR COOS COUNTY, NH TONIGHT***Today
text: A stray morning shower or sprinkle, mainly in NH, then a mix of clouds and sun from the Adirondacks and Rt. 2 north, and becoming mostly sunny south. Breezy and cool. Highs in the 60s north, to near 70 south. Winds becoming northwest 10 to 15 mph, gusting 20 to 30 mph, decreasing later in the day.

heading: Tonight
text: Mostly clear and chilly. Areas of dense river valley fog, and scattered frost in the colder mountain valleys north. Lows 40 to 45, with 30s in the colder valleys. Winds diminishing to light and variable.

heading: Tuesday
text: Areas of valley fog burning off by mid-morning. Sun, mixing with afternoon clouds north. Still cool. Highs in the upper 60s to around 70. Winds light, turning to the south this afternoon near 10 mph.
